import PrisonersDilemma.Program

open PD
namespace PD.Bots

/-- MyBot: cooperate iff the proof oracle (within budget k) derives that the opponent
plays C against me; otherwise defect. -/
def MyBot (k : Nat) : Prog :=
  .search k (.plays .opp .self .C) (.const .C) (.const .D)

end PD.Bots
